silhouette.reason: The head is larger with a shorter, wider muzzle and rounder ears, so the hump-and-head profile now reads as a bear in hero.png; the muzzle is still a little long and dog-like and the topline fur cards bristle.
fixes: shorten the muzzle a further ~10% and raise the forehead for the dished profile
lay the back fur cards flatter so the topline stops bristling

proportions.reason: The head now matches the hump better, but the trunk is still long and the legs short and thin for a brown bear in SIDE.
fixes: shorten the trunk ~10% and lengthen the legs ~8%

materials.reason: Fur cards cover the body, but the face is smooth tan plastic with a hard seam to the fur, the lower legs carry pale chalky blotches, and the paws are grey socks.
fixes: extend fur cards onto the face edge and cheeks; darker brown muzzle
remove the pale chalky blotches on the lower legs
dark leathery paw pads; glossy nose and eyes

detail.reason: Small claws now show on the paws and the ears are rounder; the face still has no brow or cheek planes.
fixes: longer, darker claws on the forepaws (brown bears have 5-10 cm claws)

wear.reason: Claw scars on the chest, a scar on the face and mud-darkened paws tell a life outdoors; the pale rubbed patch on the shoulder reads as a texture hole rather than wear.
fixes: blend the rubbed shoulder patch into the coat (shorter, lighter tips) instead of a flat pale disc
matted wet fur on the belly fringe

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 keeps the outline but the legs become straight tubes and the coat breaks into angular light/dark patches.
fixes: LOD2 legs from the sculpt with an inflate instead of tubes; average the coat colour per face

technical.reason: QA clean; 108k / 26k / 2.8k triangles over 4 draws: LOD0 trimmed toward the fur-card budget.
fixes: spend the remaining back fur-card budget on the face
